name: Shakuni
when: When the game starts
text: Welcome, dear nephew! Come, sit. The dice are fair, the board is fair, and I am the fairest of them all. Sign here, and ignore the small print. And the large print.

name: Narada
when: When the game starts
text: Narayan Narayan! A new player! Let me give you a tip: trust nobody at this table. Especially the man with the dice. And also me. Especially me.

name: Shakuni
when: When the player passes Rajasuya Yajna (Start) and collects coins
text: Collecting your coins from the Rajasuya Yajna? Wonderful! Spend them quickly. Saving money only gives you time to think, and thinking has never helped anyone win against me.

name: Narada
when: When the player buys a kingdom
text: You bought a kingdom! Congratulations! Now everyone knows exactly where to land to ruin your day. I have already told them. You're welcome.

name: Shakuni
when: When the player lands on Hall of Dice
text: The Hall of Dice! My home ground. A little advice: bet big, believe in luck, and never ask why my dice roll the same number so often. It's called talent.

name: Narada
when: When the player pays rent
text: Paying rent again? Don't be sad. Think of it as a donation to a more successful ruler. Someone has to fund the fort, and it clearly isn't going to be you.

name: Shakuni
when: When the player builds a fort
text: A fort! Excellent strategy. Walls solve every problem, except the rent, the taxes, and the fact that I'm already inside.

name: Narada
when: When the player lands on Kamyaka Forest (exile)
text: Kamyaka Forest exile! Peace, fresh air, and nobody to bother you. Use this time to reflect on your decisions. Don't take too long though. The others are busy buying your kingdoms.

name: Shakuni
when: When the player is running low on coins
text: Running low on coins? No problem, I can lend you some. Interest is only slightly more than your entire kingdom. Think of it as a friendly family arrangement.

name: Narada
when: When the player lands on Dwarka Haven
text: Dwarka Haven! Krishna's neighborhood. Safe, peaceful, and for once I have nothing to say. Enjoy it. Silence is rare when I'm around.

name: Shakuni
when: When the player draws a card
text: Draw a card, dear player. Fate is such a lovely thing. Of course, fate has a very good relationship with me, so don't expect miracles.

name: Narada
when: When a rival buys a kingdom
text: Your rival just bought the kingdom you were saving up for. Did I whisper your plan in their ear? I would never. Okay, maybe once. Okay, twice.

name: Shakuni
when: When the player proposes a trade or alliance
text: A deal between friends! I love friends. They never read the contract carefully, and they always forgive me afterwards. Eventually. Probably.

name: Narada
when: When two players form an alliance
text: Two players have become allies! How touching. I give it three turns. I could make it two, if somebody asks nicely.

name: Shakuni
when: When the player is in the lead
text: You are winning? How alarming. Let me adjust the dice... I mean, let me congratulate you warmly. Pride comes before a fall. Preferably yours.

name: Narada
when: When the player lands on Magadha
text: Magadha! Home of Jarasandha, the king who got split in two and came back together. Learn from him: some problems come back, especially unpaid rent.

name: Shakuni
when: When the player lands on Gandhara
text: Gandhara, my beloved homeland! Free advice: stay as long as you like. The hospitality is excellent and the exit is surprisingly hard to find.

name: Narada
when: When the player has a lot of coins
text: So rich! So powerful! I'd tell you who is jealous of you, but then I'd have to tell them you know. And that's no fun. Actually, it is. Let me go.

name: Shakuni
when: When the player goes bankrupt
text: Lost everything? Splendid! A man with nothing has nothing left to lose, except his dignity, and honestly that went a few rounds ago. Care for another game?

name: Narada
when: When the game ends
text: The game is over! My advice for next time: ignore everyone's advice, including mine, and especially Shakuni's. Narayan Narayan!

name: Shakuni
when: Randomly, at any time during the game (trash talk)
text: You roll like a man who has never lost. Strange, because you haven't won either.

name: Narada
when: Randomly, at any time during the game (trash talk)
text: Everyone is talking about your strategy. They're laughing, but they are talking.

name: Shakuni
when: Randomly, at any time during the game (trash talk)
text: Take your time, dear player. Take all the time you want. I only need one good roll.

name: Narada
when: Randomly, at any time during the game (trash talk)
text: Your kingdoms are so poor, even the gossip about them is boring. And I can make anything interesting.

name: Shakuni
when: Randomly, at any time during the game (trash talk)
text: Even Yudhishthira lost his kingdom on my board. You are just trying to lose yours more slowly.

name: Narada
when: Randomly, at any time during the game (trash talk)
text: I have seen sages with more business sense than you, and they live on air.

name: Shakuni
when: Randomly, at any time during the game (trash talk)
text: Your luck is truly impressive. I have never seen anyone so consistently unlucky without my help.

name: Narada
when: Randomly, at any time during the game (trash talk)
text: Narayan Narayan! Is that your final move? Please say yes, I have already told everyone it was.

name: Shakuni
when: Randomly, at any time during the game (trash talk)
text: Don't worry about losing. Losing is just winning that is taking a very long route.

name: Narada
when: Randomly, at any time during the game (trash talk)
text: You play like a Kaurava with a Pandava budget. Nobody is sure who to feel sorry for.
